text:
If you’ve got outdoor plans, today is the one to use: mostly sunny, dry, and pleasantly mild with a high right around 71. A north breeze at 5 to 10 mph keeps it comfortable, and the lake should stay friendly, with waves a foot or less. Tonight, clouds build and temperatures settle near 52.

Saturday is the less certain day. Expect a mostly cloudy, breezy feel and plan on the 60s, though the forecasts differ sharply on the high, from the mid 60s to the mid 70s. Showers might stay away, or they could reach Burlington as the coastal storm moves along, so I’d bring a rain jacket rather than trust a fully dry forecast. On the water, north winds strengthen to 10 to 15 knots with waves building as high as 3 feet. Take the sunny window today, and keep Saturday plans flexible.
